$comment: Provenance for every portrait this repository SHIPS for one of its own personas. The rule is
the one assets/pads/MANIFEST.json and assets/art/breaks/MANIFEST.json state, and it is not
relaxed for a face: CC0 or an equivalent public-domain dedication, and attribution-requiring
work is refused rather than credited, because a radio station has nowhere to put a credit and
the obligation would travel to the operator in silence.
A portrait has one more rule a break picture does not need: it is a picture of NOBODY. Every
persona this repository ships is an invented character, so a photograph of a real person,
however freely licensed, is refused here too. Licence waives the photographer's copyright and
says nothing about the subject's likeness, and a stranger's face would then be presenting as
somebody they are not on every install.
`key` is `personas.key`, the stable name `persona.defaults.ts` seeds, and the file is named
after it: a new portrait is a file named for its persona plus a line here, and nothing in the
code learns its name. `sha256` is of the file, and it is what makes an entry checkable by
somebody who was not here.
These are DEFAULTS, and they reach a station only at two moments: when a fresh station is
seeded with its personas, and when an operator presses Restore. Never at an ordinary boot,
because an operator who removed a portrait meant it, and a boot that put it back would make
removing one impossible to express -- the argument PersonasService.seed already makes about a
deleted persona. A persona that already has a portrait is never touched, so an operator's own
upload always wins.
